page_title: MON 0-0 HAM | B. Monchengladbach v Hamburger SV 24/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is penalised for a foul. Sascha Stegemann had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90+4' Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul.

90+2' What a chance that is! Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the left post!
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' A goal, which was scored by William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger), was disallowed due to offside.
86' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Giorgi Gocholeishvili as he is replaced by William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger).
86' Merlin Polzin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jonas Meffert (Hamburger) replacing Nicolas Capaldo.
85' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) has tested the patience of referee Sascha Stegemann and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
83' Substitution. Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Philipp Sander walks off.
83' Gerardo Seoane has decided to substitute Haris Tabakovic and he is replaced by Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach).
79' What a miskick by Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
77' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Lukas Ullrich walks off the pitch to be replaced by Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach).
77' The substitution is prepared. Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Fabio Cristian Chiarodia.
74' Here is a change. Alexander Rossing-Lelesiit is going off and Merlin Polzin gives the last tactical orders to Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger).
74' Ransford Konigsdorffer comes off the pitch to be replaced by Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger).
70' That's unlucky! Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
69' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Miro Muheim (Hamburger), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
68' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away. Good work from Hamburger SV as they win a corner.

68' Alexander Rossing-Lelesiit (Hamburger) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Moritz Nicolas is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. Now Hamburger SV have a corner.
66' Merlin Polzin has decided to make a change. Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) replaces Emir Sahiti.
66' Substitution. Kevin Stoger is replaced by Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach).
66' B. Monchengladbach take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

65' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going inside the right post, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The ball is out of play. B. Monchengladbach will have a chance to score from a corner.
64' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from B. Monchengladbach comes to nothing.
60' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot goalwards, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
59' Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
56' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.
55' Flag up against Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
49' The Hamburger SV players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) is caught offside!
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

44' What a chance! Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) squanders a promising opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the right post!
43' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Sascha Stegemann stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
42' Hamburger SV are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
38' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

37' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts. The ball goes out for a corner. B. Monchengladbach can continue in their attacking effort.

37' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to B. Monchengladbach.
36' Moritz Nicolas leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Alexander Rossing-Lelesiit (Hamburger).

36' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger. Hamburger SV have a corner.

35' Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Hamburger SV.
34' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) was quite harsh and Sascha Stegemann didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

33' Moritz Nicolas makes a brilliant save! Emir Sahiti (Hamburger) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the right side of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
31' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
28' B. Monchengladbach work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

28' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Daniel Heuer Fernandes pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The ball goes out of play. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a corner kick.
25' B. Monchengladbach are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
22' Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
21' Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
19' Jordan Torunarigha (Hamburger) was too forceful with his tackle and Sascha Stegemann interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

16' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but it goes well wide of the left post.
16' There's an opportunity for Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

16' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick.
14' Emir Sahiti (Hamburger) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
10' A quickly taken corner by B. Monchengladbach.

10' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. B. Monchengladbach force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
5' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
4' The ball is cleared after Alexander Rossing-Lelesiit (Hamburger) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee signals a corner kick to Hamburger SV.
2' Moritz Nicolas comes off his line to intercept the corner from Alexander Rossing-Lelesiit (Hamburger).

2' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Hamburger SV will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

The players are out at last! B. Monchengladbach will take the kick-off.
Sascha Stegemann will officiate today.
